label: Bible Study
prompt: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without _____.
verse: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
note: God's open invitation to the thirsty — come buy wine and milk, and bring no money.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not _____ from every one of us:
verse: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:
note: Paul tells the philosophers of Athens that God isn't hiding — He's not far from any one of us.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Be ye therefore _____ of God, as dear children;
verse: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
note: Modern versions say 'imitators' — Paul's picture is dear children copying the parent they love.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that _____ the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.
verse: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.
note: Little foxes raided vineyards in bloom — small troubles can wreck a budding love.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my _____ are kindled together.
verse: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
note: God's heart turns within him over Ephraim — 'my repentings are kindled together.' Love wrestling with justice.
